_readme: Labelled trigger corpus. `expect` is the skill that should be selected, or null for none.
`kind` records why the case is here: coverage, near-miss (two of our skills compete), or negative.
Prompts are written the way a real user types — file paths, company context, casual phrasing,
typos, partial information. A corpus of clean keyword-matched phrases measures nothing, because
the failures that matter are the ambiguous ones.
Scored by scripts/run-trigger-evals.mjs. Thresholds live in test/tier3/thresholds.json.
